title: Order Drafting & Automated Stock Reservation / Locking Engine Review Package
author: Antigravity & Codex

overview.goal: Atomic inventory soft-locking and order drafting to prevent overselling across 6 channels
overview.summary: Implemented StockReservationManager with atomic SQLite reservation, automatic 15-minute soft locking on SKU stocks, auto-release of expired locks, subtotal/shipping fee discount calculations (free shipping for 2+ items), and REST API endpoints /api/dashboard/orders/draft and /api/dashboard/orders/confirm.
